name: Ra
summary: An auction and set-collection game set in ancient Egypt where players bid suns for tiles over three epochs.
rules_text: Place board with a Ra track and an 8-space auction track. Bag holds tiles. Each player gets a random set of numbered sun tokens face up. On your turn you must do one: draw a random tile from the bag and place it on the next auction space, except Ra tiles go on the Ra track and trigger an auction; play a God tile from your collection to take a matching tile from the auction track; or invoke Ra to start an auction. In an auction players clockwise from the Ra player may bid a face-up sun higher than the last bid or pass. Highest bidder takes all auction tiles and the center sun, placing his bid sun face up in the center and his new sun face down. Face-down suns return next epoch. Disaster tiles taken force discarding two matching tiles. An epoch ends when the Ra track fills or all suns are spent. Score collections, play three epochs, most fame wins.
